summary: Frontend-only verification of HeartLink responsive Discover + Bottom Navigation fix. Tested 5 viewports (Small 360x780, Medium 393x852, Large 412x915, Tablet 800x1280, Landscape 915x412). All portrait viewports meet the >=24px gap requirement between action buttons and bottom navbar. Card sizes proportionally, buttons scale via CSS variables, and navbar is visible on all pages (Discover/Likes/Alerts/Chats/Profile) without covering content. Like/Pass advance to next profile. Swipe counter pill shows '50'.

ui_bugs.issue: Landscape 915x412: gap between action-buttons and bottom nav = 23px, which is 1px below the 24px minimum requirement. All portrait viewports are compliant.

When a profile has a broken/invalid profile_picture URL (e.g., 'Interstitial Test' seed profile), the renders a broken image icon instead of falling back to the gradient+initial. Currently the fallback only triggers when allPhotos[photoIndex] is falsy, not on image load error. Consider onError handler.

issues: Card properly constrained by max-w-md (~448px) creating large black side gutters. Working as designed but might benefit from a subtle backdrop styling on tablets.

measurements.swipe_counter: 50 (verified visible on top-right of card across all viewports)
measurements.like_pass: Both advance to next profile (Interstitial Test -> Demo User -> New User)
measurements.navbar_on_all_pages: Visible at bottom on /discover, /likes, /notifications, /matches, /profile at y=791..844 on 390x844

action_items: MINOR: In safeArea.js, bump minimum --card-pad from Math.max(24, ...) to Math.max(26, ...) OR add landscape-specific handling (when isLandscape=true, ensure card-pad >= 26). Current landscape 915x412 produces 23px measured gap.
MINOR: Add onError handler to profile-card to fall back to gradient + initial when profile_picture URL fails to load (visible for 'Interstitial Test' seed profile).
PRIOR (not re-verified): React warning 'Received true for a non-boolean attribute jsx' still appears in console — likely a <style jsx> attribute leaking to DOM in some component.
PRIOR (from iter 21): Verify LikesYouPage.jsx has 'import { API } from @/config/api'.
critical_code_review_comments: safeArea.js measure() creates/removes DOM probes on every resize event. Consider throttling/debouncing the resize listener to avoid layout thrash on rapid viewport changes.
safeArea.js: window.screen.height - window.innerHeight heuristic for safeBottom is unreliable in split-screen/rotated states; guard against gap > 200 to prevent inflated insets.
DiscoverPage.jsx (385 lines): still large — extracting ProfileCard, ActionButtons, and OutOfSwipesModal would improve maintainability.

DiscoverPage: useEffect early-returns via 'return () => unsub()' when user.id is truthy — swipe count/extra swipes localStorage init runs BEFORE the WS block so is unaffected, but code ordering is subtle. Consider splitting into two useEffects.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow: navigate to /auth, fill 'Enter email or phone' + password, click [data-testid="login-submit-btn"]. Set localStorage.heartlink_daily_reward_date to today's ISO date-only string ('YYYY-MM-DD') to skip daily reward modal. Discover page selectors: profile-card, pass-btn, superlike-btn, like-btn, action-buttons, swipe-counter, bottom-nav, nav-{discover,likes,notifications,matches,profile}. CSS variables to inspect on <html>: --nav-inner, --nav-total, --card-pad, --action-offset, --btn-lg/md/sm, --safe-bottom. Layout requirement: gap between action-buttons bottom edge and nav top edge must be >= 24px on all viewports.
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical issues found. Layout fix is working. Minor 1px shortfall on landscape 915x412 caused by cardPad = Math.max(24, Math.round(412*0.032)) = max(24, 13) = 24, but computed layout yields 23px due to sub-pixel rounding of card height inside calc(100dvh - 46 - 24). Bumping cardPad floor to 26 would eliminate the edge case.
